tasks.title: Rebase onto v0.11.0 (pi 1.1.0, Next 16.3.8) and reconcile the rewritten sidebar
tasks.detail:
Goal: move all fork commits from fork-next-v0.10.0 onto v0.11.0 without losing the fork's session pins or file-tab behaviour.
Files: listed above are the files git conflicts on plus the sidebar files upstream restructured in this release; `package-lock.json` belongs to the verify task.
Contract: upstream v0.11.0 rewrote the sidebar into `SessionSidebar.tsx` + `SessionTree.tsx` + `SidebarMenu.tsx` + `session-catalog-helpers.ts`, added project groups/archive/project pins, and bumped Next to 16.3.8 and pi to 1.1.0. Upstream's "pins" are *project* pins — never confuse them with the fork's session pins (`lib/session-pins.ts`, `lib/session-list-rows.ts`, `pinnedSessionIds`). Resolution policy:
- Sidebar files: take upstream verbatim first, then re-apply only the fork's session-pin surface: the pinned section header, `pinnedSessionIds` from the session list payload, the toggle call to `POST /api/sessions/pinned`, and row heights from `lib/session-list-rows.ts`. Where upstream's own row model (`lib/session-list-rows.ts` may now conflict) already solves windowing, extend it instead of keeping two models.
- AGENTS.md: keep upstream text and re-add the fork sections, updating any paragraph that describes the old `SessionSidebar.tsx` layout so it names the new files.
- README.md, package.json: same policy as the previous hop (fork attribution kept, upstream body/deps/version taken, codemirror deps re-added).
- Remaining conflicts: take upstream, re-apply fork-only additions as specified in phase_1 TASK-001.
Steps:
1. `git rebase --onto v0.11.0 fork-next-v0.10.0`.
2. Resolve per policy, commit by commit, `git rebase --continue`.
3. Confirm `git log --oneline v0.11.0..HEAD` still shows exactly the fork commits (plus any fix commits from phase_1).
Verify: no conflict markers (`git grep -n '^<<<<<<<'` empty), `git status` clean, `git rev-list --count v0.11.0..HEAD` equals the fork commit count carried from phase_1.
Done when: the rebase is finished and the fork's session-pin surface exists in the new sidebar structure.
tasks.progress: [2026-10-23T07:23:39Z] rebase --onto v0.11.0 v0.10.0 selesai (catatan: percobaan pertama salah range --onto v0.11.0 fork-next-v0.10.0 sempat membuang commit; dipulihkan via git reset --hard fork-next-v0.10.0, lalu range benar). Konflik: AppShell (useTheme+useFontPreferences), ChatWindow (union), package.json (codemirror + pi 1.1.0), files route (getFileTreeHiddenReasons + getLanguage), rpc-manager (buang usesExactSystemPrompt yang sudah dihapus upstream, simpan sudoPasswordSourceRef), SessionSidebar diambil --ours karena upstream menulis ulang sidebar. TEMUAN PENTING: upstream v0.11.0 sudah punya session pins lewat app/api/sessions/ui-state + lib/session-ui-state.ts, jadi implementasi pin fork (lib/session-pins.ts, session-pin-order.ts, session-list-rows.ts, app/api/sessions/pinned) DIHAPUS dan sidebar memakai model upstream. i18n duplikat (sidebar.pinned/pin/unpin) dibersihkan dan nilai upstream dipulihkan. Commit 036992d. tsc exit 0, npm test 2775 pass / 0 fail.

tasks.title: Rebase onto v0.11.1 and tag both hops after verification
tasks.detail:
Goal: absorb the small v0.11.1 fix release and produce a green, tagged v0.11.1 state.
Files: only `package.json` (version), `package-lock.json` (regenerated), and `AGENTS.md` if upstream documents new behaviour there.
Contract: v0.11.1 keeps pi 1.1.0 and Next 16.3.8 and is fix-only, so expected conflicts are limited to version/package metadata; anything else means upstream slipped a refactor into the patch release and must be resolved with the phase_1 policy.
Steps:
1. `git rebase --onto v0.11.1 v0.11.0`.
2. Resolve any conflict with the carried policy, then `npm install`.
3. `node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit`, `npm test`, `npm run lint`.
4. Fix drift at its source, commit, then `git tag fork-next-v0.11.1`.
Verify: tsc exit 0, tests green, lint clean, tag present, `git log --oneline v0.11.1..HEAD` equals the fork commit list.
Done when: v0.11.1 hop is green and tagged, with output recorded in progress.
